title: Quick-Kissed Brazilian Pork Hash
description: A creamy, savory, and umami-rich Brazilian-inspired dish featuring pork, onions, and spices. Ready in under 30 minutes!

ingredients.name: pork belly, diced
ingredients.notes: Cut into small cubes to ensure even cooking

ingredients.name: onion, thinly sliced
ingredients.notes: Red or yellow onions work best for caramelization

ingredients.name: garlic, minced
ingredients.notes: Use fresh garlic for the best flavor

ingredients.name: lardons
ingredients.notes: Rendered pork fat adds a rich, savory flavor

ingredients.name: cream of tartar
ingredients.notes: Helps balance acidity in the dish

instructions: Heat a large cast-iron skillet over medium-high heat and add the diced pork belly. Cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Remove the pork from the skillet and set aside. Leave the rendered fat behind.
Add the sliced onions to the skillet and cook until they start to caramelize, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly to prevent burning.
Add the cooked pork back into the skillet, along with the rendered lardons, cream of tartar, and chopped cilantro.
Season with salt and pepper to taste. Stir well to combine.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 5 minutes, allowing the flavors to meld together.
Serve hot, garnished with additional cilantro if desired.
